controlExperiment.selectionRule: candidate with shocked target-fund activation rate closest to 5000 bps in the 100-replicate paired reachability pilot; no-shock activation is diagnostic only
controlExperiment.scope: H5 control-strength/release scans and H6 control-disclosure ablation only

detection.clock: first successful Oracle snapshot whose valuation haircut exceeds the same-tick matched no-shock snapshot, then its first regulator disclosure

missingness.detection: report censored status and reason; never impute a numeric lag
missingness.settlement: report pending status and pending rate; never call it censored
missingness.failedRun: retain failure evidence and exclude from estimates only under the declared technical-failure rule

inference.intervalMethod: paired Monte Carlo normal interval with reported standard error
inference.multipleComparisonMethod: Holm adjustment within each hypothesis family
inference.effectReporting: point estimate, confidence interval, paired sample count, censoring rate

hypotheses.expectedDirection: R1/R2/R4 regulator detection lag below R3 and R0
public immediate detailed disclosure increases redemption acceleration
regulator-only or tiered disclosure preserves detection with lower coordination cost
asset and investor overlap increase loss and redemption spillovers
stronger controls reduce loss and liquidity depletion while imposing control cost
public control disclosure increases spillover demand in proximate unshocked funds

exclusionRules: pilot and calibration runs are excluded from formal results
a failed formal cell is preserved as failure evidence and rerun only with the same locked inputs
a run with a config digest mismatch is rejected before metric extraction
no regime ordering or hypothesis direction is a run-validity condition
